best_lineage.idea: The current program calls std::strtod per line and scans for newlines; the obvious tuning lever is to replace the newline skip with a direct branch-free newline scan and add a simple pre-pass that detects whether the whole text is only plain integers so we can use a faster integer path, exposing the integer-path decision as a swept parameter.
